defects.description: The term "Брандмауэры" is used instead of the required glossary equivalent "межсетевой экран" (or its plural form).
The translation "чтобы они соответствовали **Конфигурация** системы" is grammatically incorrect and does not accurately convey the source meaning "to fit the configuration of the system".
Bold markup (**Конфигурация**) is introduced, which does not appear in the source text.
